basic_info.description: Welcome to 2067 20th Avenue, a beautifully maintained home in the heart of San Francisco's sought-after Sunset District. This residence exudes timeless architectural charm of a bygone era. Upstairs, you'll find a warm and inviting formal living room featuring a classic brick fireplace, ideal for cozy evenings or relaxed entertaining. Adjacent is a dedicated dining room perfect for hosting dinner parties, and a sunny breakfast area that connects seamlessly to a thoughtfully designed kitchen with its own walk-in pantry for added storage and function. Down the hall is a traditional split bath that serves two well-proportioned bedrooms. There is an abundance of natural light thanks to generous windows and the home's desirable orientation. Downstairs, enjoy the versatility of a 1BR/1BA guest suite with a separate entrance that's ideal for extended family or guests. A spacious 1-car garage and full-sized flat lot are icing on the cake. Enjoy the best of urban living with easy access to MUNI lines, tech shuttles, Noriega/Taraval/Irving St shops, Safeway, Gus's, Stonestown Galleria, top rated schools and everyday consumer conveniences.  Outdoor lovers will appreciate nearby Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Stern Grove, S.F. Zoo and world class golf courses.
